lines.speaker: Fray Sibyla
lines.text: Did your Reverence, Fray Damaso, say that you had been twenty years in the town of San Diego and that you had left it?

lines.speaker: Fray Sibyla
lines.text: Wasn’t your Reverence satisfied with the town?
It must be painful to leave a town where one has been for twenty years and which he knows as well as the clothes he wears.

lines.speaker: Fray Sibyla
lines.text: I certainly was sorry to leave Kamiling and that after I had been there only a few months.

lines.speaker: Fray Sibyla
lines.text: But my superiors did it for the good of the Orders for my own good.

lines.speaker: Fray Damaso
lines.text: Either Religion is a fact or it is not!

lines.speaker: Fray Damaso
lines.text: That is, either the curates are free or they are not! The country is going to ruin, it is lost!

lines.speaker: Señor Laruja
lines.text: He’s in a bad humor because you haven’t treated him with deference.
